unknown_ideal_rule: do not invent I or zero input residual; compute B-R where rounded inputs known

fixture_contract.counterfactual_rule: optional separately labelled counterfactual object, never actual diagnostics; not emitted in v1.1
fixture_contract.exact_rational_display_rule: record exact rational plus explicitly labelled binary64 display metadata; ieee_nodes are exact rounded dyadics
fixture_contract.ancillary_executable_witness_rule: SELF_CHECK ancillary_input_origin declares hex-designated executable-only witnesses; copy vectors are bit-copy assertions; neither asserts actual I

bounds_applicability.arithmetic: R/B inputs known exactly as binary64, fixed production alpha/epsilon/d=1
bounds_applicability.input_and_total: only known original exact inputs; never unknown-origin actual data
bounds_applicability.separation: same-adapter same-offer same-channel frozen UG responder pairs; min N=1/5 A=1/4 B=1/10

signed_zero_required.identity_current: copy input-v bits including negative zero
signed_zero_required.assertion: exact IEEE bits, not Fraction equality or scalar tolerance

schema_kind: candidate evidence field contract; required at evidence-report envelope, fixture_contract at fixture rows

logical_layer_to_fixture_field.executable_B: nodes.u for scalar/signed-zero or executable_B for F35 nested appraisal
logical_layer_to_fixture_field.independently_derived_bounds: arithmetic_bound and, for known origin only, input_bound/total_bound
